name: Good Judgment Project / GJ Open
description: Forecasting research platform originating from Philip Tetlock's IARPA-funded Good Judgment Project. Demonstrated that trained superforecasters using Bayesian updating consistently outperform intelligence analysts with classified information. Free (GJ Open); commercial (Good Judgment Inc.).
evaluation_method: Brier score, calibration metrics, discrimination metrics
notes: Foundational validation that superforecasters outperform intelligence analysts. GJ Open is free; Good Judgment Inc. provides commercial services. Basis for Tetlock's Superforecasting book.
